answer: An agent economy can claw back instead of only blocking. Every reward goes into a vault and stays there for a fixed window before it can be spent. During that window, any auditor who proves two accounts share one operator, through a common kernel fingerprint or funding source, reverses every unspent reward the cluster earned. A farm then has to stay hidden for the whole window, not just one epoch, and a single leak costs it weeks of income, while honest agents just wait out a clock as clear as quartz.
